title: Boletim Escolar – 2026

notes: Brazilian school report card. The school name and network line beside a blue circle logo are a letterhead (furniture); the small centred line at the bottom is a footer. The student panel is a bordered 3x2 grid of small label + value fields (not a table, labels are not headings). Grades table: full grid, two-level header ("Área do conhecimento", "Componente curricular", "Média final", "Situação" span both header rows; each "Nº bimestre" spans Nota and Faltas); area cells span 4, 1, 1 and 2 rows and are repeated; decimal commas. Legend: TYPED abbreviations followed by an en dash ("AP – …"), set in two CSS columns with no other marker; listed as list items. Observations: bullets drawn by CSS. The two signature lines are body text.
